info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Reviews Submission API
info.description: The Customer Reviews Submission API enables businesses to collect and manage customer feedback related to prospect campaigns. By allowing users to submit reviews, the API facilitates enhanced customer engagement and valuable insights for sales strategies. This endpoint is particularly useful for marketing teams seeking to analyze customer sentiments and improve future campaigns. Typical consumers include sales and marketing professionals who aim to refine their outreach and build stronger customer relationships.

post.description: This operation allows users to submit a review for the specified prospect campaign execution identified by RES-100045. Providing feedback helps improve campaign performance and user engagement.
